data.one_liner: A Flutter wrapper for native Braintree SDKs supporting custom UI and payment sheets.
data.what_it_does: Wraps native Braintree SDKs for iOS and Android, allowing developers to implement either Braintree's drop-in payment sheet or a custom Flutter UI using credit cards, PayPal, and 3D Secure verification.
use_when: You need to integrate Braintree payments into your Flutter application.
You require custom Flutter-based payment UI using Braintree tokenization.
avoid_when: You need Venmo or Google Pay on Android (not currently supported by the Android v5 integration).
Your app targets iOS versions below 16.0 or Android SDK below API 23.
strengths: Actively maintained fork with modern platform support (iOS 16+, Android 12+).
Supports both custom Flutter UIs and a cross-platform payment sheet.
Includes fixes for PayPal vault flows and Xcode build issues.
weaknesses: Venmo and Google Pay are not currently supported on Android.
Requires manual configuration for Android intent-filters and iOS URL schemes when using PayPal/3D Secure.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting minSdkVersion to at least 23 on Android, setting iOS deployment target to 16.0, and configuring URL schemes or intent filters for PayPal and 3D Secure.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you prefer processing payments via Stripe instead of Braintree.

alternatives.name: in_app_purchase
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you are implementing standard digital goods in-app purchases via Apple App Store or Google Play Store.
